cell_age_note: Single-H selected/masked_dense use .25s direct-age expiry, no global periodic refresh; expired cells receive full CURRENT-stem dependencies via3/2/1/0 supports. Periodic_selected is same single-H period3 control. No old intermediate feature dependencies, but nearest-motion warp/stale unselected regions and downstream spatial mixing remain approximate. Deep cache unchanged.
compact_state_note: Selected uses projected intermediate(r) and full block output(128) pairs; parent_selected caches four128 maps. Same compressed weights. Dense full function unchanged. Projection area averages two dense and two selected projections. Compare AP/state bytes/actual MACs independently; nearest warp and zero-bias projection commute in exact arithmetic, floating paths may differ.
dependency_note: Overrides generic shared-mask/parent-state scope: final core is undilated content/uncovered union plus own-confidence support(radius4 if dependency_guard, else0); four supports dilate3/2/1/0. Recomputed final core has complete current-stem dependencies; cached outside final core remains approximate. Parent_selected is compact original shared radius4 baseline; uniform_core shares final-core selection policy but no upstream support halo. Same checkpoint and refresh; per-layer state-write and actual weighted execution areas separate.
recurrence_timing_note: Mask capture overhead included in selected/control timing; comparisons and discarded shared-input replays excluded. No pure-backend latency equivalence claimed.
scope: Projected-input spatial kernels; dense cheap 1x1 projection plus selected expensive 3x3 output rows, four own aligned FP32 activation caches. Same compressed checkpoint dense and masked-dense controls; mature uncompressed base separately. Period3/.25s and own previous confidence guard; no training/teacher injection. Actual own-recursive four-map spatial cache, whole aligned activation reuse, selected output-column mixing. Fixed heuristic threshold, no training. Dense bases (unless fused or replaced by projected-input kernels), stem/current FM and existing readout/deep cache included. Fused execution composes full-rank kernels and eliminates explicit spatial bases, with same cache/mask semantics. Areas include refresh and dilated requests, no duplicated halo outputs. Conv plus functional-linear MACsx2 excludes nonconv arithmetic. Same GPU rotating wall time includes warp/selection/gather/scatter; excludes IO/H2D/postprocess. State tensor bytes are per-mode; incremental CUDA peaks measure transient allocation above live multi-mode allocations, not standalone process VRAM.
single_state_note: Overrides generic parent/state wording: selected and masked_dense retain only final128 H; prior intermediate maps replaced by zero temporary canvases. Without cell_age, parent_selected is FOUR-map dependency model with SAME weights/core policy/refresh. With cell_age, periodic_selected is SAME single-H period3 control, age expiry enters final core before upstream3/2/1/0 supports. No uniform_core mode. Four layer update fractions and one persistent map write fraction separate; temporary allocations inside model time.
